That was the place I built...out in Watts. See, I called it Leek's Lake at first because it was uh...this guy had a ...next door, had a little old lake there where he raised bullfrogs to sell then, and I bought four, five lots along here, and I put my dance-hall over here and I called Leek's Lake. His name was Leek's Lake. His name was Leek but he had a great big place there...oh, big...bigger'n' this house...it...an' a little lake that he raised bullfrogs.
